correctness.rationale: Independently integrate quadratic Lagrange polynomials at nodes 0,-previous,-current to obtain the exact variable-step AB3 companion matrix and 2-step product; independent SymPy symbolic expansion reproduced all three claimed cubic characteristic coefficients and exact determinant at z=1. With C>0, B<1, C<1, A>C>0 under s<6/(5+2q), the cubic Schur inequalities reduce to that one determinant. At equality the unit root is simple and residual quadratic strictly stable; above root >1 by sign at z=1. q=r/(1+r)^2 yields reciprocal ratio intervals, and a rank-one r^-1 limit of large-step transfer yields the norm constant. These are for fixed positive ratio and real negative test eigenvalue, not uniform transient robustness for arbitrary step grids.
